summary.text: Karin Housley is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 33 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Nat Smith.
She is a business owner who has served in the Minnesota State Senate since 2013.

paragraphs.text: Housley was born in South St. Paul, Minnesota, graduated from South St. Paul High School in 1982, and earned a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York in 1988.
Her Ballotpedia profile lists her Senate tenure as beginning in 2013 and her current term as beginning on January 3, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session she was ranking minority member of the Capital Investment Committee and was also assigned to the Housing and Homelessness Prevention, Jobs and Economic Growth Finance and Policy, and Education Finance committees.
